selections.raw:
# logfmt() clashing labels keep the loser under `<name>_extracted`, following the base-name
# precedence stream > metadata > parsed (the same for every parser).
clear
load
  {app="a", sl="s", sm="s", tri="s"} `sl=p md=p tri=p` @ 20s [repeat every 20s for 3] [metadata md="m" sm="m" tri="m"]
  {app="noise"} "z=1" @ 20s [repeat every 20s for 3]

eval instant at 60s count_over_time({app="a"} | logfmt [1m])
  {app="a", sl="s", sl_extracted="p", md="m", md_extracted="p", sm="s", sm_extracted="m", tri="s", tri_extracted="p"} 3
eval range from 40s to 60s step 20s count_over_time({app="a"} | logfmt [1m])
  {app="a", sl="s", sl_extracted="p", md="m", md_extracted="p", sm="s", sm_extracted="m", tri="s", tri_extracted="p"} 2 3
# logfmt() label-expression form resolves the same clashes the same way.
eval instant at 60s count_over_time({app="a"} | logfmt sl, md, sm, tri [1m])
  {app="a", sl="s", sl_extracted="p", md="m", md_extracted="p", sm="s", sm_extracted="m", tri="s", tri_extracted="p"} 3

# logfmt() after `drop`: a dropped stream label does not clash with parsed keys.
clear
load
  {app="a", name="stream"} "name=parsed" @ 10s

eval select from 0 to 30s forward {app="a"} | drop name | logfmt
  {app="a"} "name=parsed" @ 10s [parsed name="parsed"]
eval select from 0 to 30s forward {app="a"} | logfmt | drop name
  {app="a"} "name=parsed" @ 10s [parsed name_extracted="parsed"]
# A label re-added after the drop is a parsed label, not a stream label: logfmt neither renames
# around it nor overwrites it, exactly as for a stream that never had the label.
eval select from 0 to 30s forward {app="a"} | drop name | label_format name="x" | logfmt
  {app="a"} "name=parsed" @ 10s [parsed name="x"]
# Grouping sees the parsed label added after the drop, matching the full label output.
eval instant at 10s sum by (name) (count_over_time({app="a"} | drop name | logfmt [1m]))
  {name="parsed"} 1

# logfmt() with a line key that ends in `_extracted`.
clear
load
  {app="a", k="s"}     "k_extracted=pext k=p" @ 20s [repeat every 20s for 3]
  {app="b", k="s"}     "k_extracted=pext k=p" @ 20s [repeat every 20s for 3]
  {app="noise", k="s"} "k=p"                  @ 20s [repeat every 20s for 3]

eval instant at 60s count_over_time({app=~"a|b"} | logfmt [1m])
  {app="a", k="s", k_extracted="pext"} 3
  {app="b", k="s", k_extracted="pext"} 3
eval range from 40s to 60s step 20s count_over_time({app=~"a|b"} | logfmt [1m])   # overlapping
  {app="a", k="s", k_extracted="pext"} 2 3
  {app="b", k="s", k_extracted="pext"} 2 3
eval instant at 60s sum by (app, k_extracted) (count_over_time({app=~"a|b"} | logfmt [1m]))
  {app="a", k_extracted="pext"} 3
  {app="b", k_extracted="pext"} 3

replay.engine: All exported times, steps and repeat intervals are integer seconds relative to upstream epoch 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z (logqltest/parser.go:19-25). Replay may shift the entire fixture to a deterministic retained epoch, preserving every relative timestamp. A repeat count includes the first entry; expand start+i*every for i=0..count-1 (parser.go:129-134). Preserve load order, noise and metadata; never flatten metadata into stream labels.
replay.fields: Expression fields are ordered [destination, source-expression] pairs; fields_expression and line_definition preserve original Go text. line_expression=testLine is resolved from the exact shared declaration at parser_test.go:1612. Parse-all has no fields column. hint_expression is inert Go source, not evaluated; the selected parse row uses NoParserHints().
replay.metrics: mode=instant has equal start/end and step=0; mode=range has its explicit step. outcome=series uses expected label maps and original numeric-string values (or sparse underscores); evaluate at start+i*step. Labels are the exact combined metric oracle, not category assertions. Preserve all per-fixture loads across its evaluations, resetting only on clear.
replay.requirements: Normal replay reads committed JSON using Elixir/Rust only, without Go, network or expectation generation. The producer is an optional provenance tool, not a test dependency.
replay.select: mode=select uses explicit direction, start/end and step=0. outcome=entries uses expected_entries: labels is the stream owner only; metadata and parsed are separate per-entry owners. Omitted category clauses become empty maps, not unknown data. timestamp and line are exact source expectations. Match all categories, text and time, not just flattened labels, following logqltest/runner.go:490-545 (categorize-labels encoding). Empty expected/expected_entries arrays are mode placeholders, NOT expect-empty assertions.
replay.strict: Run the parse row with strict_values=[false,true]. Non-strict uses want; strict uses effective_strict_want, selecting nonempty want_strict or falling back to want (parser_test.go:1460-1464). Run the expression row only with strict=false, as asserted by its harness at 1743. Do not invent a strict expression evaluation.
replay.table: base_labels is the initial stream owner, structured_metadata is attached by the harness before parsing, initial_parsed_labels={} records the absence of preexisting parsed labels after builder reset. want is the exact flat LabelsResult().Labels() assertion, NOT a categorized output oracle. Do not infer upstream owner assertions from flat labels. keep_empty=false follows the parse harness and is inapplicable to explicit expression extraction.
